text: The language of Bittern-2 is OCaml, which new contributors must know. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Godwit-8, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Pipit-9 is the Tallinn datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Pipit-9 applies to Godwit-8, the datacenter differs.
Source for Godwit-8 is written in Rust; no other language is allowed in its repository. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The yearly budget for Pipit-9 is $4515k, covering licences and hosting. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

The owner of Bittern-2 is the Compass team, and every change to Bittern-2 goes through their review. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Pipit-9, which is 2050 requests per minute.

Wren-7 reaches its retirement date on August 13, 2028, so every consumer has to migrate before then. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
